  • 方法详细资料

    • isTamed

      boolean isTamed()
      Check if this is tamed 检查此实体是否已被驯服

      If something is tamed then a player can not tame it through normal methods, even if it does not belong to anyone in particular. 如果某实体已被驯服，玩家就无法通过常规方法驯服它，即使它并不属于任何特定的人。

      返回:
      true if this has been tamed 若已被驯服则为 true

    • setTamed

      void setTamed(boolean tame)
      Sets if this has been tamed. Not necessary if the method setOwner has been used, as it tames automatically. 设置此实体是否已被驯服。如果已使用 setOwner 方法则无需调用此方法，因为那样会自动驯服。

      If something is tamed then a player can not tame it through normal methods, even if it does not belong to anyone in particular. 如果某实体已被驯服，玩家就无法通过常规方法驯服它，即使它并不属于任何特定的人。

      参数:
      tame - true if tame 若驯服则为 true

    • getOwner

      AnimalTamer getOwner()
      Gets the current owning AnimalTamer 获取当前拥有它的 AnimalTamer
      返回:
      the owning AnimalTamer, or null if not owned 拥有它的 AnimalTamer；若无主人则为 null

    • setOwner

      void setOwner(AnimalTamer tamer)
      Set this to be owned by given AnimalTamer. 设置由给定的 AnimalTamer 拥有此实体。

      If the owner is not null, this will be tamed and will have any current path it is following removed. If the owner is set to null, this will be untamed, and the current owner removed. 如果主人不为 null，此实体将被驯服，且正在跟随的任何路径都会被移除。如果主人被设为 null，此实体将变为未驯服状态，并移除当前主人。

      参数:
      tamer - the AnimalTamer who should own this 应拥有此实体的 AnimalTamer
